description: One nozzle set as it is actually plumbed on a boom or an air-blast tower: what tip, what pattern, what it flows at what pressure, and how coarse the droplet is. It is a MASTER rather than a line on an application because the same tips go out fifty times a season and the number an inspector asks for — gallons per acre at the speed that was driven — is arithmetic off this record and the ground speed, not something anybody should be retyping into every spray. Droplet class is here because it is the drift control on most labels: a label that says 'apply as Coarse or coarser' is naming this column.

fields.description: What the crew calls this set — 'Air blast upper', 'Herbicide band 8003'. It is the docname, so it is what every application points at.

fields.description: The ISO colour code moulded into the tip — the thing a person actually reads standing at the boom. Stored as text rather than a Select because the colour vocabulary is the manufacturer's, not this app's.
fields.label: Orifice Colour

fields.description: A set that has come off the machine. Kept rather than deleted: applications made through it are still on the record and still have to resolve their nozzle.
fields.label: Disabled

fields.description: Gallons per minute PER NOZZLE at the rated pressure, off the manufacturer's chart. Per nozzle rather than per boom, because the number on the chart is per nozzle and a record that quietly multiplied it would be a record nobody could check against the chart.
fields.label: Flow Rate (GPM per nozzle)

fields.description: The pressure the flow rate was read at. A tip flowed at a pressure other than this one does not flow at this rate, and the difference is the square root of the pressure ratio — which is why the pressure belongs beside the flow rather than in somebody's memory.
fields.label: Rated Pressure (PSI)

fields.description: ASABE S572 droplet size class. This is the drift control on most labels — 'apply as Coarse or coarser' is an instruction about this column — so it is a first-class field rather than a note.

fields.description: Where the spray is aimed. 'Canopy Upper' and 'Canopy Lower' are the two halves of an air-blast tower and are the ordinary case for a dual set on tree fruit.

fields.description: Distance between tips along the boom. With the count and the flow rate this is what turns GPM into gallons per acre at a ground speed.
fields.label: Nozzle Spacing (inches)

fields.description: How many tips of this set are open during an application. A tower with alternate tips plugged flows half what its spacing suggests, and that is a deliberate setting rather than a fault.
fields.label: Active Nozzles

fields.description: Effective swath width. Left blank for an air-blast set, where the swath is the row spacing rather than a property of the machine.
fields.label: Boom Width (ft)
